short.en: Step back by each kind of coin

t.zh: 用 1 元、2 元、5 元的硬币凑出 7 元，最少要几枚？又有几种付法？
t.en: With 1, 2 and 5 yuan coins, how do you make 7 yuan with the fewest coins? And how many ways are there to pay it?

t.zh: 格子 i 记着凑出 i 元的答案。
t.en: Cell i holds the answer for making i yuan.

t.zh: 这一关的扫描臂按每种硬币各退一枚来扫：有几种硬币，就送来几格。退到 0 元以下的是「界外」。
t.en: This level’s sweep arm sweeps by stepping back one coin of each kind: as many kinds of coin, as many cells it sends. Stepping back below 0 yuan lands “out”.

goal.zh: 用给定的几种硬币凑钱。先算最少要几枚硬币，再算一共有几种付法（先付哪一枚算不同的付法）。凑不出来就是「—」。
goal.en: Make each amount from the given coins. First work out the fewest coins needed, then how many ways there are to pay (paying the coins in a different order counts as a different way). An amount that can’t be made is “—”.

how.zh: 这一关有两个阶段，电路板会留到第二阶段。
how.en: This level has two stages, and the circuit board carries over to the second.

hints.zh: 最后一枚可能是任何一种硬币：点扫描臂，它送来付这一枚之前（每种硬币各退一枚之后）的格子。
hints.en: The last coin can be any kind: click the sweep arm, which sends the cells from before paying it (one coin of each kind stepped back).

hints.zh: 加法器能给一整段的每个数都 + 1（算上最后这一枚），再接「取较小」。
hints.en: An Adder can + 1 to every number in a whole run (counting this last coin), then wire it into “min”.

hints.zh: 0 元不需要硬币：「是 0 元」放行一个 0。
hints.en: 0 yuan needs no coins: let a 0 through on “is 0 yuan”.

ask.en: What is the fewest coins needed?

body.zh: 同一张表，换个问题：一共有几种付法？想想要换哪个元件。
body.en: Same table, a different question: how many ways are there to pay? Think about which component to swap.

hints.zh: 最后一枚是哪一种都行，每种都算。
hints.en: The last coin can be any kind, and each kind counts.

hints.zh: 0 元算一种付法（什么也不付）：「是 0 元」放行一个 1。这次不用 + 1 了。
hints.en: 0 yuan counts as one way to pay (paying nothing): let a 1 through on “is 0 yuan”. No + 1 this time.

ask.zh: 一共有几种付法？先付哪一枚，算不同的付法。
ask.en: How many ways are there to pay? Paying the coins in a different order counts as a different way.

body.zh: 扫描臂按每种硬币各退一步，因为最后一枚可能是任何一种。求最少几枚，取较小再 + 1；数付法，就加起来。
body.en: The sweep arm steps back by each kind of coin, because the last coin can be any kind. For the fewest coins, take the min and + 1; to count the ways to pay, add them up.

body.zh: 看看第二个问题的答案：1 + 2 和 2 + 1 被算成了两种。表只记「凑到了几元」，不记用过哪些硬币，所以先付哪一枚就算不同的付法。只想数组合的话，得一种硬币一种硬币地加进来，就像。
body.en: Look at the answers to the second question: 1 + 2 and 2 + 1 were counted as two ways. The table records only “how much has been made”, not which coins were used, so the order you pay in makes a different way. To count combinations only, you would have to bring the coins in one kind at a time, like .

note.zh: 凑零钱：最后一枚可能是任何一种硬币，来路就是每种硬币各退一步。
note.en: Making change: the last coin can be any kind, so the ways in are one step back by each kind of coin.
